subject: Invoice originator and temporary email-bridge for portal onboarding
messages:
From: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@synergia-analytics.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: accounting@synergia-analytics.com
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Invoice originator and temporary email-bridge for portal onboarding

Hi Markus,

We're kicking off billing for the Redwood contract (legal: Synergia Analytics Inc.). A couple of items from our AP team as we set up:

- Who on Redwood will be the invoice originator (the system/user that issues the invoice)? Our AP system needs that for reconciliation.
- We prefer to receive invoices through your portal, but our portal team needs ~6-8 weeks to accept the integration.
  Could we ask for email copies (PDF) to accounting@synergia-analytics.com as a temporary bridge for 60 days while the portal is configured?
- Our process requires PO numbers on every invoice (format: SY-#######).
- VAT certificate attached (vat_certificate.pdf) — confirm you have this on file.

If you can outline the short-term fallback (email copies + signature requirements) and the long-term portal enrollment steps, that would help us map internally.

Thanks,
Olivia Barnes
Senior AP Manager
Synergia Analytics

From: markus.klein@redwood.com
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@synergia-analytics.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Invoice originator and temporary email-bridge for portal onboarding

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and a proposed path: 

1) Invoice originator: Redwood Inference billing system will emit invoices; the recorded "issuer" will be Redwood Inference (Tax ID on file). If you need a specific user/accounting contact listed as the creator we can add a creator field (e.g., accounts-payable@redwood.com) for your reconciliation.

2) Short-term bridge: portal-first, email-copy fallback. We will: 
   - Enroll Synergia as a portal customer (recommended long-term).
   - During portal onboarding (target ~6 weeks) we will send monthly PDF invoice copies to accounting@synergia-analytics.com. Those PDFs will include a standard signed-page stub (electronic signature image) for AP acceptance.
   - The temporary email copies will be enabled for 60 days by default; if you need longer we can extend.

3) PO numbers: we will include a PO field on the invoice and require it to match SY-#######. Please confirm whether PO is mandatory for first invoice or can be added on subsequent invoices.

4) VAT evidence: we've received the attached VAT cert (thanks). We'll tag your account with VAT status and ensure the invoice includes the VAT line item per EU rules.

I've attached our AP onboarding checklist and a sample XML payload so your integration team can preview schema (attachments: ap-checklist.xlsx, sample-invoice.xml).

Next steps I propose:
- Olivia: confirm PO requirement for the first invoice and any remit address differences.
- Kimberly (cc): can you enable the portal temporary email bridge and configure the delivery window?
- Grace (cc): will coordinate the portal invite and entity verification.

I'll hold off the first invoice until we have confirmation of the PO rule and the portal/email setup.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@synergia-analytics.com>, markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 10:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Invoice originator and temporary email-bridge for portal onboarding

On Tue, Aug 18, 2026 at 11:03 AM markus.klein@redwood.com wrote:
> I've attached our AP onboarding checklist and a sample XML payload so your integration team can preview schema (attachments: ap-checklist.xlsx, sample-invoice.xml).

Hi Olivia — Kim from Billing Ops here. Operational details: 

- The temporary email bridge will be set up to automatically send a PDF copy to accounting@synergia-analytics.com on invoice publish.
- A quick note on signatures: the email PDF will contain an embedded e-signature image that our AP accepts as evidence. If your internal policy requires a certified signature (e.g., DocuSign) we can route a one-off signed PDF for the first invoice.
- Token/ack flow: we support an ephemeral ack token if you want machine-level confirmation. Token life = 48 hours; it appears in a machine-readable header and a small JSON ack payload accessible via the API. Let us know if you want that enabled.
- PO validation: we can optionally reject invoices that do not contain a valid SY-####### PO. If you need that safety, confirm and we'll enforce on our side.

Operational timeline:
- Today: we enable email-copy bridge and tag VAT evidence.
- Target 30 days: portal invite + entity verification (Grace to send).
- Target 60 days: portal fully accepted by your team, bridge off.

HubSpot ticket created for the onboarding: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/ticket/98124.
DocuSign one-off: https://www.docusign.com/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=prod&token=abc123

If that all sounds good I'll enable the bridge and set PO validation to optional for the first invoice (unless you ask otherwise).

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@synergia-analytics.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: accounting@synergia-analytics.com
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Invoice originator and temporary email-bridge for portal onboarding

Thanks Markus/Kim — that works for us. A few confirmations from AP: 

- PO is mandatory for the first invoice. We'll ensure the PO is created and provided before the invoice is finalized.
- We accept the embedded e-signature image for the temporary bridge. No DocuSign required unless the portal enrollment slips past 30 days.
- Please enable the ephemeral ack token (48h) so our automation can confirm delivery.
- We'll take the portal invite; please have Grace send the verify request and entity form.

I'll follow up with the PO (SY-2026-00421) and confirm remit address if it differs from the VAT cert.

Appreciate the fast coordination — cc'ing finance.

Best,
Olivia Barnes
Senior AP Manager
Synergia Analytics
